evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and touches only CMake build files (CMakeLists.txt, cmake/*.cmake).
rationale: Fixes CMake introspection test snippets that falsely fail or abort configure when `-Werror` flags are injected via `APPEND_CXXFLAGS`, and fixes `clang-cl` rejection of `-msse4`. As the author notes, snippets failed to compile due to warnings like uninitialized reads and implicit conversions, incorrectly disabling optimizations or failing to detect `std::atomic` entirely.
